captions.detailed: A compact desktop printer featuring a low, light gray rectangular body with a sloped front-right control console. It includes a flat scanner bed cover on top, a dark gray front paper exit tray, and a sloped control panel containing small push buttons, a dark display screen, and a rotating black control dial. The scanner lid can swing upward along its rear hinge, while the front output tray can fold down, and the main input tray slides outwards from the lower front.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a compact desktop printer. The model should include a low rectangular main body with a sloped front-right control strip, a flat scanner lid on top, a front output shelf, and a sloped console equipped with small prismatic push buttons, a display, and a rotating menu dial. Ensure the scanner lid rotates on a rear hinge, the paper tray slides prismatically, and the output shelf folds on a front hinge.
captions.factory: Create the main printer body using a box primitive, and cut a sloped face on the front-right using a chamfer or boolean subtraction to form the control console. Construct the scanner lid as a thin box and position it on top with a revolute joint representing the rear hinge. Model the control interface by adding small box primitives for the push buttons, a thin dark box for the display screen, and a cylinder for the rotating dial. Finally, model the front paper tray and output shelf as thin shell parts, attaching them with prismatic and revolute joints respectively.
